So you have come, ⟦0⟧. First, try giving a concert in this city. The programme you choose and whom you seat where decide the reception. In a concerto, everything turns on the choice of soloist.
Splendid. Next, gather companions. Approach a musician in this city with 'Persuade'. The knack is to find the approach that suits their taste.
When you have more players, go to the rehearsal room. There you choose who goes on tour and give them instruments and bows. Fine instruments can be had from dealers… but beware of fakes.

Once the party is chosen, go on tour. You play the venues one night at a time, and each ovation on the grand master's stage crumbles the city's stronghold. Bring it all the way down and the city is yours.
Now, set out. Every night, look at the audience and choose your playing style. Force a player at the limit on stage and they will leave the orchestra.

That is all the basics. From here, do as you please. Win cities, fill the seats, and aim for the legendary grand concert. Press the ⓘ beside fame or stamina for an explanation. …Oh, and do be very careful of the odd players you come across in town.
